sloka: यो निवेशः तु अभिप्रेतः भरतस्य महात्मनः ।भूयः तम् शोभयाम् आसुर् भूषाभिर् भूषण उपमम् ॥२-८०-१६॥
transliteration: yo niveśaḥ tu abhipretaḥ bharatasya mahātmanaḥ ।bhūyaḥ tam śobhayām āsur bhūṣābhir bhūṣaṇa upamam ॥2-80-16॥

translations.english: Those authorised ordered the artisans to perform their respective tasks. Thereafter, they selected lovely tracts of land filled with trees bearing varieties of sweet fruits as restingplace for great Bharata and decorated them so splendidly, that they looked like ornaments themseleves.
